% imakeidx's indexes: the main one, and an index of names with its title
% and style file (test-imakeidx.ist, which puts no comma between an entry
% and its numbers). Each number links back to its \index.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{imakeidx}
\makeindex
\makeindex[name=names,title=Index of names,options=-s test-imakeidx.ist]
\begin{document}
Groups\index{group} were named by Galois\index[names]{Galois}; Euler's
theorem\index[names]{Euler}\index{theorem!Euler's} came first.
\printindex
\printindex[names]
\end{document}
